thread:
Sara: Heads-up — postmortem draft uploaded. We need owners for the remaining mitigations from the model-registry + auth cascade. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-1234 :eyes:
Nate: reading now. main open items I see: 1) auth token refresh fallback, owner? 2) model-registry queued writes fallback, owner? 3) cross-region failover test schedule
Olga: I'll take token refresh fallback. Plan: add short-circuit to local K/V cache + alpha fallback to earlier token provider. ETA Wed EOD.
Kevin: I'll own model-registry queued writes fallback. Action: add queue drain and backoff on writes; run full replay test. ETA next Tue.
Maya: I can coordinate the cross-region failover test — propose dry-run on Friday 10:00 PDT with SRE oncall.
incident-bot: Incident INC-1234 severity downgraded to P2. Timeline updated.
SRE-oncall: FYI I'll join the dry-run and can simulate region-loss with network egress rules. Need runbook steps in repo: path: infra/runbooks/vendor-fallback.md
Sara: I've added a short runbook draft to infra/runbooks/vendor-fallback.md — please add step-by-step playbook items and a checklist. Also add rollback owners.
Nate: Suggest we add a recurring cron to rotate provider tokens weekly to catch TTL issues; will open a PR by tomorrow.
Olga: putting PR up today. Small snippet:
```
# fallback config
FALLBACK_PROVIDER=auth-alt
TOKEN_REFRESH_RETRIES=3
```
Kevin: For the model-registry, I'm adding a soft-fail mode that returns 503 with hint to client to hit cached model. Will also update SDK docs.
Maya: Requesting ownership matrix in the doc: who verifies runbook, who runs dry-run, who owns post-dryrun cleanup. I'll draft a table.
Sara: Great. Let's assign owners on each line item in the postmortem and set target completion dates. We should also schedule a 30m follow-up after the dry-run to validate lessons.
Olga: Confirmed owner for auth fallback: Olga (token refresh), deadline 2026-03-30.
Kevin: Confirmed owner for registry write fallback: Kevin, deadline 2026-04-05.
Maya: Cross-region dry-run booked Fri 2026-04-02 10:00 PDT. Invite sent.
Nate: I'll file the infra task to automate provider token rotations: INFRA-487. ETA 2026-04-10.
Sara: Thanks all. @SRE-oncall please post results and reopen if anything fails. :thumbsup:
SRE-oncall: Will do. Logging plan: enable extra debug for registry writes during test.
Sara: Closing the loop — I'll update the postmortem with owners/times by EOD today.
Kevin: Also flagging recurring incident pattern: we've had 3 vendor auth hiccups in last 6 months — can we add monthly vendor-health review to the ops cadence?
Maya: +1. Added to ops agenda for next week.
Nate: FYI partner-eng says vendor has tentative engineering fix; will maintain contact and update timeline.
Sara: Perfect. Meeting note: owners need to close PRs and runbook updates before dry-run. After dry-run we'll mark items 'validated' or 'needs follow-up'.
Olga: A couple of small TODOs in the runbook I've added comments on.
Sara: Thanks — ping me if anything blocks.
